paragraphs: Family Expense Tracker is a production-grade personal and household finance application designed to help individuals and families track, analyze, and optimize their financial life. Built with modern web technologies and a focus on privacy and user experience, it offers a seamless cross-platform experience with offline PWA support, advanced AI-powered transaction parsing, multi-currency tracking, and automated SEO prerendering for search visibility.
features: Natural Language Processing: Simply type or speak (e.g., "Spent 500 on groceries") to record transactions automatically.
Voice Commands: Integrated microphone support for hands-free entry using OpenAI Whisper.
Smart Insights: Ask conversational queries like "How much did our family spend on food last month?" for instant summaries.
Multi-Account & Wallet Tracking: Manage cash, bank accounts, credit cards, and family budgets in a unified dashboard.
Smart Budget Alerts: Establish monthly category thresholds and receive real-time visual progress warnings.
